apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.1 — SequencePlayer migration Phase P-B: Raga Listen scales now play through the shared SequencePlayer core via a thin ScaleAdapter (same notes, durations and end timing; the piano highlight comes from the unified ticker). The 880 Hz test beep moved to its own helper. Ear-test gate: a scale at tempo 240 with the piano highlight tracking the sound.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Scales migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-B).
